blocks.text: clientLoader prepares route data in the browser. It can read a local public JSON file and return the values a page needs.

Use React Router 7 framework mode, the continuation of Remix's framework approach. Save files at the shown app paths. Set ssr:false in react-router.config.ts for this browser-only course. React tooling is required.

`clientLoader` runs route data work in the browser. Return the values that the route component will read.

blocks.text: The route reads the real JSON file and shows one item per book.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: Check failed responses. A public JSON file is readable by every visitor and should contain no secrets.
